mapper.insert: INSERT INTO qnas ( training_id, user_id, trainer_id, question, created_at ) VALUES ( #{trainingId}, #{traineeId}, #{trainerId}, #{question}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT q.qna_id AS qnaId, q.user_id AS userId, q.question_title AS questionTitle, q.question AS question, q.answer AS answer, q.created_at AS createAt, q.answered_at AS answeredAt FROM qnas q WHERE q.training_id = #{trainingId} ORDER BY q.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE qnas SET answer = #{answer}, answered_at = NOW() WHERE qna_id = #{qnaId}
